notes: Uses the Kemen Tour 10 28mph build (src link); Orbea also sells 20mph and MID versions. Orbea's US configurator gives no speed spec, range, weight or max load. Electric Bike Journal's review lists an older price range ($3,799 – $4,799) and says the 10 has an 11-speed CUES drivetrain, while the current Tour 10 build lists Gates belt parts, so drivetrain/price may have changed since the review; motor (EP6, 85Nm) and 630Wh battery match. N+1 Bikes price ($5,248.95) is higher than Orbea's $5,071.
